ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Central Bank of India has appointed Shri Rajesh Ranjan, a retired IPS officer with 36 years of experience in vigilance, fraud risk management, and corporate governance, as a Shareholder Director. This three-year appointment, effective August 1, 2026, strengthens the bank's board oversight in critical areas like compliance and governance, with no apparent red flags or disclosed conflicts of interest. The disclosure is a routine regulatory filing under SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations.
